neighbours.label: the token that completes the magnitude of a multi-digit or large quantity (trailing digits of 60, 7,000, 86400, or the word 'thousand'), as against single-digit quantities in the same sentences
fire: The old library holds more than 30,000 books in its basement.
Each panel weighs about 250 kilograms when fully assembled.
Last year the charity planted twelve thousand trees in the hills.
We drove nearly 900 miles in two days to reach the coast.
The concert hall can seat 2,500 people on three levels.
A typical blue whale weighs around 150 tonnes as an adult.
In total, five hundred volunteers helped clear the beach.
The tank holds 80 litres of water and cools the engine.
quiet: The old library holds more than 3 shelves of maps in its basement.
Each panel weighs about 2 kilograms when fully assembled.
Last year the charity planted a few trees in the hills.
We drove nearly 9 miles in the rain to reach the coast.
The concert hall can seat a small orchestra on its stage.
A typical blue whale calf drinks milk for about 7 months.
In total, five volunteers helped clear the beach.
The tank holds 8 litres of water and cools the engine.

predictions: fire 0.3-0.7 on trailing digits or 'thousand/hundred' of large counts; single-digit amounts below 0.05
notes: Card: '0' x17 (8640|0, 7,00|0, 6|0 inches, 21,00|0 acres), also '8' in 48, '2' in 32. Probe: 7,000 0.659, 86400 0.645, 60 inches 0.410, 45,000 0.303, 48 bars 0.531, 120 people 0.234; spelled 'seven thousand' 0.538 (so the meaning, not only the digit, fires); '6 inches' 0.012.
